facts.business: ESDS Software Solution Limited is an AI-enabled cloud, managed services, data centre infrastructure and software solutions provider offering IaaS, managed services, and SaaS, including GPU-as-a-Service, from its five Tier III data centres in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: AI cloud infrastructure agreement for dedicated cluster of approximately 8,208 NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Australia
Five Tier III data centres in Nashik, Navi Mumbai, Bengaluru, Mohali and Noida with combined area of over 75,266 sq ft
Commenced operations at data centre in Noida during FY26
Expanded portfolio to include fully managed GPUaaS offering in November 2025
